labels.reason: All supplied source units were reviewed. Reported parameters at four dose levels, dosing context, sampling counts, plasma assay, LLOQ and animal characteristics provide partial input evidence for DRQ002, DRQ003, DRQ007, DRQ008 and DRQ013. Concentrations are stated to occur only in Fig. 2 and are not digitized; this item contains no concentration-time observations. DRQ010 and DRQ011 have a source-reported borrowed unbound percentage, explicitly not measured here. DRQ023 and DRQ024 have reported AUC and Cmax candidates, but free-exposure definitions and matched MIC/response relationships remain unresolved. These requirement links indicate partial evidence, not completed requirements or scientific acceptance.

evidence.quote: PK parameters after intraperitoneal dosing, non-neutropenic infected mice
S04 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.01491-16 | Table 2 (Rudramurthy et al. 2017)

Female Swiss albino mice 20-25 g, 4-5 weeks, non-neutropenic, disseminated A. flavus infection. INTRAPERITONEAL 5, 10, 20, 40 mg/kg once daily for 7 days from 24 h after infection. PK in 90 infected mice sampled on DAY 2 OF TREATMENT (predose, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 h), 3 per time; plasma HPLC-UV, LLOQ 0.05 mg/liter.

Footnote a: "AUC∞_pred, AUC extrapolated to infinity using the last predicted concentration; AUC∞_D_pred, dose-normalized AUC∞_pred." Unbound fraction not measured; the authors used 29.87% from S03. Concentrations in Fig. 2 only (not digitized).

findings.reason: The supplied item identifies S04, the study population and plasma HPLC-UV, but does not explicitly name the administered drug or measured analyte. Project-wide voriconazole identity does not establish this item's identity.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed confirmation of the administered drug, measured analyte and salt/free-base or other dose basis, linked to S04 Table 2.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: F0003:S1:T6:A71 supplies the day-2 sampling schedule, counts, matrix, assay and LLOQ; A72 states that concentrations are in Fig. 2 only and are not digitized. Table body values are reported parameters, not concentration observations or individual animals. Parameter summary definitions, variability, experimental-unit identifiers, actual versus nominal timing and numerical time origin are unspecified.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time source values or separately documented figure extraction; sampling and summary definitions, available variability, missingness metadata, identifiers where available, and explicit time origin. Retain reported parameters separately.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: four dose groups and a once-daily seven-day schedule are stated, with PK on treatment day 2. Actual prior administration times and concentration-time contrasts across treatment days are not supplied. This page does not establish time-dependent clearance or permit parameter transfer between doses or days.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported dosing-event histories, sampling-time origin and eligible concentration-time records for the dose/day contrasts intended for downstream assessment.

findings.reason: MI004 remains CONFLICT, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: conflicting mouse binding sources and percentage interpretation prevent selecting a single defensible free-exposure conversion. F0003:S1:T6:A72 explicitly reports an unmeasured, borrowed unbound fraction of 29.87% from S03. Supplied SC030 instead describes 29.97% unbound in plasma, alongside 78% bound in serum and an unspecified-basis 67% secondary-table description; the rat 64-66% basis also remains unspecified. The discrepancy is retained without averaging, correction or conversion under SC031.
findings.needed_material: Source-specific confirmation of the S03 value, percentage definition, binding species and matrix, experimental context and applicability to S04. Carry unresolved alternatives and fu sensitivity forward.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A72 provides a borrowed unbound percentage and explicitly says it was not measured here. Binding measurement method, measurement species and matrix, temperature, pH, concentration range, recovery, nonspecific binding and mass balance are not supplied. The plasma PK matrix does not establish the borrowed binding measurement's matrix; the table's total/unbound basis is unstated.
findings.needed_material: Source-specific binding metadata and the concentration basis of the reported PK parameters before any free-exposure derivation. Blood/plasma partition is conditional on an intended basis change.

findings.reason: MI006 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: animal PK model support and design-permitted evaluation are unresolved. This item contributes dose-specific reported parameters and day-2 design context, but cannot establish supported mouse and rat structures, saturable elimination, time-dependent clearance, identifiability or permitted held-out prediction. SC022's conditional choices remain for the downstream PK assessment.
findings.needed_material: Prepared eligible observations and study-design evidence for downstream assessment of SC022; retain unsupported or unassessable components as limitations.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: source-reported mouse parameters, health/infection state and a 20-25 g study range are available candidates. Individual study weights, complete parameter definitions and concentration basis are not established here. This single mouse study does not establish cross-species coverage or qualify a parameter for human extrapolation.
findings.needed_material: Reuse these candidate definitions and study context; obtain actual study body-weight inputs if required by a considered scaling approach and resolve parameter comparability in the translation inventory.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: dose-specific AUC∞_pred values are available, explicitly extrapolated using the last predicted concentration. They are not established as free AUC; their lower integration limit and time origin are unspecified. No matched isolate MIC, response record, endpoint window or source-supported exposure-response link is provided.
findings.needed_material: A source-supported AUC definition and window, justified free-exposure basis, matched isolate MIC and eligible response/regimen linkage before fAUC/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: source-reported dose-specific Cmax values are available. Sampled versus model-predicted peak definition, peak window, total/unbound basis and parameter variability are unspecified. No matched isolate MIC or response linkage is supplied.
findings.needed_material: Peak definition and window, justified free-exposure basis, matched isolate MIC and eligible response/regimen linkage before fCmax/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: MI010 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at index: eligible matched PK/PD records remain unresolved. This page contains infected-mouse PK parameters but no response records or matched isolate MICs. Organism context alone cannot establish matching, comparable index regressions or supported targets under SC017, SC032 and SC033.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported matched exposure, dosing-history, isolate MIC and response records separately by organism and endpoint, or a documented determination that an index or target cannot be established.

findings.reason: The 5, 10, 20 and 40 mg/kg doses in A71 repeat the dose-group values in A74:A77. They are note/table duplicates, not additional administrations or independent records.
findings.needed_material: Carry the stated-value list separately to preparation for confirmation while preserving its relationship to the existing dose-group rows.
